sentences.en: After the bone has set, the cast will be removed.
sentences.zh: 骨头愈合后，会把石膏拿掉。

sentences.en: The candidate whom I cast a vote for was elected.
sentences.zh: 我投给那位候选人的票使他当选了。

sentences.en: She listened to him with her eyes modestly cast down.
sentences.zh: 她低垂着眼睛听着他说的话。

senses.zh: 投射，加…于; 分配角色
投，掷，抛，扔; 铸造物；塑件; 石膏; 演员表，全体演员
